items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse

insight.digest: 据 TechCrunch 转述，亚马逊与 Meta 正讨论让 Muse 连接亚马逊商城，搜索结果呈现和广告安排仍在谈判。
insight.analysis: 当 Agent 接手商品筛选，零售商需要重新决定搜索排名、广告曝光和售后归属。这些商业安排会影响接入速度。
insight.takeaway: 跟踪双方是否公布合作，以及排名与订单责任如何分配。

items.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse

insight.digest: 沃尔玛通过 Agent Gateway 把商品发现、比价和建购物车接入 Muse。用户可设消费上限并要求购买前确认。
insight.analysis: 沃尔玛保有商品检索与购物车接口，Muse 负责接收意图。分工覆盖下单前的主要环节，也给用户留下确认点。
insight.takeaway: 评估同类购物 Agent 时，测一遍预算限制、购买确认和订单回查。

items.title: Brazil crime-fighting AI startup Pax expanding to three more regions

insight.digest: 据路透社采访，巴西创业公司 Pax 拟把其面向警方的 AI 试点拓展到三个新地区，已获得 4,000 万美元种子融资。
insight.analysis: 扩展信号来自新增地区试点。是否能跨地区复制，取决于数据接入、采购流程和可审计性。
insight.takeaway: 下次跟踪试点转采购的数量，以及是否公布独立效果评估。

items.title: Huang's return to Nvidia brings open-weight AI debate to forefront in Washington
MHRA sets out regulatory approach to next generation innovation

insight.digest: 英国 MHRA 与新加坡 HSA 的监管创新通道进入首个实际运行阶段，先以 AI 辅助选择流感疫苗抗原为案例。
insight.analysis: 两地监管机构可在开发早期协调证据问题，仍分别适用各自的审批标准。公告属于合作进展。
insight.takeaway: 关注试点会公开哪些共同证据要求，以及 2027 年是否扩大参与范围。

items.title: As AI spend shifts toward clinical care, IT decision-makers take their time
Public Healthcare AI Network launched in South Korea

insight.digest: 韩国启动公共医疗 AI 网络试点，通过电子病历接入本地验证的医疗 AI，计划到 2029 年连通全国 72 家公立医院。
insight.analysis: 把 AI 放进现有病历入口有利于减少工作流切换。跨院推广还要验证数据字段一致性、适用人群和实际使用情况。
insight.takeaway: 跟踪已接入医院数、实际活跃使用量和各医院是否公开本地验证结果。

items.title: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months

insight.digest: Simon Willison 用自己的任务复盘模型能力变化，其中一个转折是编码 Agent 的默认产出开始稳定达到日常使用要求。
insight.analysis: 产品能力拐点往往体现在人工纠正次数和任务交付时间。一次成功演示很难衡量日常接手成本。
insight.takeaway: 从真实用户工作中抽取三种高频任务，每次换模型记录首轮可用率、纠正次数和总用时。

items.title: Clinical decision support for precision dentistry: Trends and emerging prospects.
items.summary: Background Precision oral health requires clinicians to consider patient-specific clinical, biological, behavioral, imaging, and preference sensitive data when making clinical decisions. In routine oral health care, however, these data are often fragmented across electronic dental records, imaging platforms, diagnostic tests, narrative notes, and patient-generated sources. Clinical decision support (CDS) systems provide a mechanism for organizing these data and translating them into timely, evidence-informed recommendations at the point of care. Types of studies reviewed A narrative review was conducted of peer-reviewed literature relevant to precision dentistry, CDS, dental informatics, artificial intelligence, biomarkers and omics technologies, and patient-generated health data. Priority was given to dental studies, which were supplemented by broader medical CDS literature when dental-specific evidence was limited. items.title: Large Language Model Prediction of Subsequent Ultrasound BI-RADS Categories from Pre-Imaging Clinical Information in Symptomatic Breast Patients: An Exploratory Retrospective Study.
items.summary: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown promising performance in image-based breast lesion analysis, but the ability of large language models (LLMs) to predict subsequent ultrasound (US) BI-RADS categorization from pre-imaging clinical information remains less well characterized. Aim This exploratory study evaluated whether an LLM could predict subsequent US BI-RADS categories using clinical information and whether the addition of physical examination findings altered predictive performance. Methods This retrospective single-center exploratory study included 120 women with breast-related complaints who underwent breast ultrasonography. Two LLM-based workflows were evaluated: a clinical-only workflow and a clinical-plus-physical-examination workflow. US BI-RADS served as the imaging reference outcome.
